title: cityPack manifest.json v0.1
description: VILLE cityPack manifest schema (CC0). Every geometry element carries a required synthesis_tier and a provenance row reference; no element may omit them. See spec/SPEC.md for the pack layout.

pack.description: Slug name of the pack directory, e.g. 'ile-de-la-cite-block'.

spec_version.description: cityPack spec version this manifest targets.

epoch.description: Epoch label this pack reconstructs, e.g. '1860s-haussmann-pre'. A pack is one epoch of one block; the year-slider composes packs.

license.description: Optional pack-level license note. Per-element licenses live in provenance.jsonl.

methods.description: Path to the generated methods.md for this pack.

synthesis_tier.description: Mandatory honesty field. none=direct geometric import; minimal=DUSt3R/splatting on dense photo; light=DUSt3R/MASt3R on sparse photo; mixed=fusion with diffusion/prior infill; heavy=declared fabulation. Read as two bands: evidence-grounded={none,minimal,light}, fabulated={mixed,heavy}.

entity_id.description: External IDs. Overture GERS is primary; OSM id + Wikidata QID are the documented fallback. At least one of (overture | osm+wikidata) must be present.

geometry.description: Path to the entity's glTF/glb inside the pack.

provenance.description: Reference to the row in provenance.jsonl for this element. Conventionally 'provenance.jsonl#<row_id>'. Per-field provenance is mandatory (hard rule).

media.description: Source photos / engravings the element was reconstructed from, license-stamped per element in provenance.

fragments.description: Markdown narrative seeds attached to the element.
